transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started. As we all know, we received a deficiency letter from the regulator on our pediatric monitoring device, and we have 30 calendar days to submit our written response. A draft has been circulated internally, but it still has unresolved gaps — specifically around software scope, lot disposition, the pediatric indication, and which patient-data fields we'll commit to. Before we can finalize anything, we need to close those open items and make sure our position is consistent across all four areas the regulator flagged. I'd like to hear from each of you where things stand on your end so we can align on a path to submission.

Dana, the calibration deviations on lots L17 and L18 need a hold and investigation plan, and that must be reflected in our corrective-action section given the regulator's manufacturing controls question. Theo, we'll build in both deidentification of the data and small-cell suppression with a threshold of fewer than 10 patients per reporting cell.
